title: Desk bridge v0: brain
description: Talk to the brain through the core: the core holds the session, its lease and the brain client, and streams the answer back as brain.turn events. The core also reads the brain's agent directory (agents, A2A cards, spaces and A2A tasks, specs/brain/v0) and says whether the brain can be reached. Scoped by brain:converse; brain.ask, one question answered through a tool in a session of its own, by brain:ask.

BrainSayRequest.description: Say something to the brain in the desk's current session.

BrainSayResult.description: Result of brain.say: the answer arrives as brain.turn events with this id.

BrainAskRequest.description: Ask the brain one question and get the answer as structured values: the arguments it calls the caller's tool with.

BrainAskParams.description: Parameters of brain.ask: what to ask and the tool whose arguments are the answer.

prompt.description: The question, with everything the brain needs to answer it. The desk's conversation is not sent.

BrainAskTool.description: The tool the brain must call to answer, a ToolDefinition of specs/brain/v0. The core never runs it: the arguments go back to the caller.

name.description: The tool's name, for example propose_theme.

description.description: What the tool is for and when to call it, for the brain.

schema.description: A JSON Schema 2020-12 of the arguments. Its type is object; it may $ref the desk's own specs by their $id.

BrainAskResult.description: Result of brain.ask: the answer arrives as brain.turn events with this id, for the caller only.

BrainAgentsListRequest.description: List the person's agents one page at a time, as the brain's listAgents does.

BrainAgentsListParams.description: Parameters of brain.agents.list: the query of listAgents (specs/brain/v0). A field left out takes the brain's default.

status.description: Only agents with this status, an AgentStatus of specs/brain/v0.

page.description: The page to read, from 1 (the brain's default is 1).

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 100 (the brain's default is 20).

BrainAgentsListResult.description: Result of brain.agents.list: the brain's AgentList (specs/brain/v0), items newest first and pagination, passed through unchanged.

BrainAgentsCardRequest.description: Read one agent's A2A card, as the brain's getAgentCard does.

agentId.description: The agent's id, as brain.agents.list lists it.

BrainAgentsCardResult.description: Result of brain.agents.card: the brain's AgentCard (specs/brain/v0), passed through unchanged.

BrainSpacesListRequest.description: List the spaces the person can open, as the brain's listSpaces does.

BrainSpacesListResult.description: Result of brain.spaces.list: the brain's SpaceList (specs/brain/v0), passed through unchanged.

BrainTasksListRequest.description: List the A2A tasks agents handed each other one page at a time, as the brain's listA2ATasks does.

BrainTasksListParams.description: Parameters of brain.tasks.list: the query of listA2ATasks (specs/brain/v0). A field left out takes the brain's default.

targetAgentId.description: Only tasks this agent is doing.

status.description: Only tasks with this status, an A2ATaskStatus of specs/brain/v0.

page.description: The page to read, from 1 (the brain's default is 1).

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 100 (the brain's default is 20).

BrainTasksListResult.description: Result of brain.tasks.list: the brain's A2ATaskList (specs/brain/v0), items newest first and pagination, passed through unchanged.

BrainStatusRequest.description: Which brain the desk talks to, and whether it can be reached now.

BrainStatusResult.description: Result of brain.status: a brain on this machine with its model, a brain in the cloud, or offline.

BrainStatusLocal.description: A brain on this machine, named by the model it runs.

BrainStatusCloud.description: A brain over the network, such as endue AI. credits is left out while the brain reports none.

BrainStatusOffline.description: The brain cannot be reached now, or the desk has none.

BrainTurnEvent.description: Progress of a brain.say or brain.ask turn.

BrainTurnData.description: Payload of brain.turn. delta carries answer text; error and offline carry a sentence for people. A brain.ask turn's completed carries structured when the brain called the tool. tool and tool-result carry tool: a brain.say turn's hand-off to a plugin command and its return (ADR 0084).

structured.description: brain.ask only, on completed: the arguments the brain called the tool with, checked against its schema. Absent when the brain answered in text instead.

BrainTurnKind.description: started, delta (more text), completed; error (the turn failed, for example read-only after a takeover); offline (the brain is unreachable, the turn waits) and online (it resumed); tool (Eris hands work to a plugin command: the core runs the brain's call) and tool-result (the command answered and its answer went back to the brain).

BrainTurnTool.description: tool and tool-result only: the command a brain.say turn's tool call runs, so the desk can show Eris going to its plugin and coming back (ADR 0084).

callId.description: The brain's tool call id; a tool-result names the call it ends.

provider.description: Who provides the command: a plugin id, or desk for the runtime's own.

ok.description: tool-result only: whether the command answered without an error.
